paths.title: PMP 2026 Project Leadership Specialist
paths.target_role: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Delivery Lead

milestones.rationale: Build current PMP people/process reasoning and delivery-tailoring fundamentals.
Connect business environment, value, evidence and scenario diagnosis.
Validate exam-style and senior delivery judgement.
Integrate people, process, governance and value in one complex project exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Progresses from leadership and delivery fundamentals through business/value reasoning to integrated project judgement.
paths.status_rationale: Physical coverage exists across current PMP people/process/business domains, evidence review, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and integrated capstone.

paths.title: Strategic PMO and Portfolio Governance Specialist
paths.target_role: PMO Analyst / PMO Manager / Head of PMO
entry_prerequisites: Project-management fundamentals and organizational governance awareness

milestones.rationale: Establish PMO mandate, services and portfolio-governance foundations.
Connect value measurement, evidence review and PMO credibility diagnosis.
Validate governance and executive PMO judgement.
Integrate operating model, portfolio governance and PMO value in one redesign exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Mandate and service design precede portfolio governance; value/assurance reasoning precedes operating-model redesign.
paths.status_rationale: The corpus covers PMO purpose, services, governance, portfolio assurance, value measurement, evidence review, troubleshooting and integrated PMO redesign.

paths.title: Professional Scrum Delivery Specialist
paths.target_role: Scrum Master / Product Owner / Agile Delivery Lead
entry_prerequisites: Basic product or project delivery familiarity

milestones.rationale: Establish Scrum theory, accountabilities, events, artifacts and commitments.
Develop coaching, flow, value and anti-pattern diagnosis.
Validate practical and senior Scrum judgement.
Integrate empiricism, quality, self-management and value in one team-effectiveness exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Framework literacy comes first; professional coaching and anti-pattern diagnosis follow before integrated team improvement.
paths.status_rationale: The corpus covers Scrum theory, accountabilities, artifacts, commitments, coaching, flow, evidence review, assessment, interview and integrated capstone.

paths.title: Agile and Adaptive Delivery Specialist
paths.target_role: Agile Delivery Lead / Product Delivery Lead / Transformation Practitioner

milestones.rationale: Build agile mindset, lifecycle selection and flow fundamentals.
Connect product thinking, enterprise agility, flow evidence and anti-pattern diagnosis.
Validate adaptive-delivery and enterprise judgement.
Integrate flow, feedback, metrics, product value and governance in one delivery-system redesign.

paths.dependency_notes: Mindset and delivery-continuum understanding precede flow optimization and enterprise-scale adaptation.
paths.status_rationale: The corpus covers agile values, adaptive lifecycle choice, flow, product thinking, evidence review, anti-pattern diagnosis, assessment, interview and integrated capstone.

paths.title: ITIL Digital Service Management Specialist
paths.target_role: IT Service Manager / IT Operations Manager / Service Delivery Lead
entry_prerequisites: Basic IT operations or service-delivery familiarity

milestones.rationale: Establish current ITIL value-system, dimensions and operational-practice foundations.
Connect continual improvement, experience, service evidence and operational decision-making.
Validate modern service-management judgement.
Integrate restoration, problem/change governance, service levels and continual improvement in one service exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Value-system understanding precedes operational-practice integration; evidence and continual improvement precede full service-management integration.
paths.status_rationale: The corpus covers current ITIL foundations, operational practices, service levels, continual improvement, evidence review, assessment, interview and integrated capstone.
